about: Marker types used in this dataset. A marker records a span of text inside a cell that is highlighted in the source edition. Each marker has a type and the exact text of the span. The definitions below are the author's own, taken from the Color Code guide published on chaver.com; the colour named with each type is the colour that highlight carries in the printed and web editions. The hex value with each type is the colour that class carries in the site's own stylesheet, where markers are rendered as coloured text rather than as a background highlight.

types.definition: Direct parallels between all segments of a horizontal thread.
Key words that appear in both the first and second segments of a three-part horizontal thread.
Key words that appear in both the second and third segments of a three-part horizontal thread.
Repeating words or phrases within multiple segments of a warp thread.
Parallels between parts of a single segment.
Linguistic connections between the first weft thread and the last, creating an envelope.
The half chiasm created by the connection between the upper left segment and the lower right segment.
The half chiasm created by the connection between the upper right segment and the lower left segment.

groups.Horizontal links: Connections across columns within the same row.
groups.Boundary links: Connections between the opening and closing weft threads of the unit.
